products.name: Windows 11 Healthcare Endpoint Baseline (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: A single, repeatable Windows 11 endpoint baseline for clinical and corporate devices, delivered through Microsoft Intune — configuration, security, update, and power tuning, assigned once and inherited fleet-wide. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
One proven Windows 11 baseline for every clinical and corporate endpoint

Moving a hospital or clinic fleet to Windows 11 without a defined baseline means every device drifts: inconsistent security settings, power options that put shared clinical PCs to sleep mid-shift, missing update behavior, and no documented standard to audit against. This solution gives you a single, repeatable Windows 11 endpoint baseline delivered through Microsoft Intune — configuration profiles, the settings catalog, a referenced security baseline, update behavior, and power/display tuning for always-on shared clinical devices — assigned once and inherited by the whole fleet.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what a Windows 11 baseline is, the configuration profile + settings catalog + security baseline model, update behavior, and power/display tuning for shared clinical vs. personal corporate devices.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported Windows 11 edition/hardware, device groups, a referenced security baseline) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: device groups, configuration profiles, the settings catalog baseline, the security baseline reference, update rings, power/display profiles, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — baseline-readiness discovery, per-device baseline validation, a fleet baseline-drift report, safe remediation of drift, and a baseline-target group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Windows 11 endpoint on one documented, auditable baseline — consistent security, update, and power behavior for shared clinical and corporate devices alike — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • W11HC-Discovery.ps1 — Windows 11 baseline readiness and current posture
    • W11HC-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation; force an MDM sync so the baseline re-applies
    • W11HC-Report.ps1 — fleet-wide baseline status + OS-build inventory (Microsoft Graph)
    • W11HC-Set-BaselineTargeting.ps1 — create the baseline targeting device groups (Microsoft Graph)
    • W11HC-Validation.ps1 — confirm the Windows 11 baseline has applied to this device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
